【原视频简介】
I built a voice-powered AI app using **Fish Audio S2.1 Pro API + MCP** to see if AI voices can actually sound like real performances. Instead of basic text-to-speech, I tested emotion control, voice design, multilingual speech, real-time streaming, and even connected it to an AI agent workflow.

**Try Fish Audio API + MCP:** https://fish.audio/?fpr=alexandru44

In this video you'll see:

* Build a voice-powered AI app from scratch
* Connect the Fish Audio S2.1 Pro API
* Test emotion and performance tags
* Create a custom AI voice
* Add voice output to an AI workflow with MCP
* Explore real-time streaming and multilingual support

According to Fish Audio, **S2.1 Pro API** supports **83 languages**, voice cloning, voice design, expressive speech generation, and MCP integration for AI agents. The current free access is intended for experimentation under Fish Audio's Fair Use Policy.

**Sponsored by Fish Audio.**

If you're building AI apps, voice agents, avatars, or automation workflows, let me know what you'd build with it in the comments.
